stem.text: A battery is connected to three resistors of resistances $12\,\Omega$, $6\,\Omega$ and $2\,\Omega$, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a battery, a 3 A current label, a 12 Ω resistor and a 6 Ω resistor in parallel, and a 2 Ω resistor in series with them.

stem.text: The current from the battery is $3\,\text{A}$.
What is the value of the ratio $\dfrac{\text{power dissipated in the resistor of resistance }6\,\Omega}{\text{power dissipated in the resistor of resistance }2\,\Omega}$?
